device.description: 8-bit 1.25 MSPS single-channel parallel ADC with control registers, CSTART and INT/EOC
device.note: tlv571.pdf (SLAS239A) p.1 pinout, p.2 terminal functions, p.3 register addressing, p.4 Figure 2 control registers and hardware configuration, p.5 Tables 1-3 conversion modes, programming examples, power down, p.6-7 sampling/conversion and start of conversion, p.12 output format and power up, p.16 recommended operating conditions, p.19 timing requirements

registers.name: CR0
registers.note: Figure 2 (p.4): control register zero, written with D7-D6 (A1-A0) = 00; D1-D0 don't care; zeros after hardware configuration (p.4)

registers.name: CR1
registers.note: Figure 2 (p.4): control register one, written with D7-D6 (A1-A0) = 01; D5, D3, D2, D0 reserved (write 0)

commands.name: Write CR0
commands.note: Figure 2 (p.4): A(1:0) = D7-D6 = 00 selects CR0; latched on the WR rising edge (p.2); with CR0.D5 = 1 the WR rising edge also starts sampling (software start, Table 1 p.5)

commands.name: Write CR1
commands.note: Figure 2 (p.4): A(1:0) = 01 selects CR1 (Table 2 example 2: 01 000010 = 2s complement)

ready.note: CR0.D4 = 0: INT, one pulse twL(INT) = 1 SYSCLK after each conversion (p.19; 111 ns at the 9-MHz minimum oscillator)
CR0.D4 = 1: EOC, high to low at the start of conversion, back high at its end (Table 1, p.5)

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (sampling frequency, register addressing), p.4 (Figure 2, hardware configuration), p.5 (Tables 1-3), p.6 (sampling/conversion), p.7-8 (start of conversion), p.12 (system clock, output format, power up), p.16 (ROC), p.19 (timing requirements)
notModeled: analog input, references: every conversion returns the 0 V code (00h binary; 2s complement (CR1.D1 = 1) of the unipolar range puts REFM = 0 V at 80h, modeled as codeFormat offset)
the control registers cannot be read back (no read-back mode is documented); reads always return the conversion result

start of conversion: hardware start (CR0.D5 = 0, CSTART rising) and software start (CR0.D5 = 1, WR rising edge, then each RD rising edge) are both always enabled: the CSTART pin, a CR0 write with D5 = 1 and every completed read start a conversion regardless of CR0.D5; a CR1 write in software start mode does not start one

conversion time: 6 SYSCLK sampling + 10 SYSCLK conversion = 16 SYSCLKs (p.6, p.19) at the internal oscillator minimum (9 MHz slow, CR1.D4 = 0: 1778 ns; 18 MHz fast: 889 ns); with the external CLK (CR0.D3 = 1) modeled as 0; hardware start converts in 10 SYSCLKs after CSTART rising (not distinguished)
hardware configuration mode (WR tied low, dummy RD loads defaults) and CLK setup/hold windows: not modeled
software power down by CS high (Table 3, p.5), CR0.D2 SWPWDN, auto power down: no bus-visible effect
data bus timing at DVDD = 3 V, 50 pF (p.19): tAcc = ten(RDL_DAV) 40 ns, tDf = tdis(RDH_DAV) 10 ns
variants: 8-bit single-channel member of the TLV1571 family (DW and PW share the 24-pin numbering).
